name: SymfonyLive Germany 2027
description: German Symfony conference, 15 talks, workshops beforehand
note: on-site, English talks (German Q&A in workshops); early bird 399 EUR until 2 Dec 2026
details: Successor of SymfonyLive Berlin, now in Cologne. Workshops on 18-19 May, main conference with 15 talks on 20-21 May 2027; talks in English per the Symfony blog, workshop trainers also answer in German. Conference-only early bird 399 EUR excl. tax until 2 December 2026, then 499 EUR; workshops 990 EUR. The venue name 'Kupferwerk' is taken from the address line, the page does not name it separately.
